name: Hamhung
registryAssessment: No Hamhung city/local cadastral custodian or DPRK public parcel registry/map was evidenced. South Korean national-agency material references North Korea land-information and cadastral-original-map work, but not an anonymous public Hamhung parcel service.

officialSources.role: K-GeoP / Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport National Spatial Information Center
officialSources.observation: Official Korean national land-information portal. Public landing page loaded, but it is a South Korean service and no DPRK/Hamhung parcel layer was exposed.
Official map route advertises parcel information and map selection. Direct GET of the map page timed out after 20 seconds; no login, CAPTCHA bypass, credentials, or private token was used.

officialSources.role: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport official notice
officialSources.observation: Official notice for cadastral-original-map database standards; search-indexed text references building a North Korea land-information DB, but does not provide a Hamhung parcel service or safe parcel geometry.

officialSources.role: Korean public-data portal cadastral-map index dataset
officialSources.observation: Official dataset describes national cadastral-map index coverage for South Korea; its stated spatial scope is 대한민국 전체 (South Korea), so it was not treated as Hamhung evidence.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe anonymous Hamhung parcel geometry response or native parcel identity was obtained; no GeoJSON sample retained.
